summary:
Three machines. Two worlds. Stories that outlived their missions.

The Forgotten Explorers is a short educational documentary telling the stories of three NASA machines left behind on the Moon and Mars: the Apollo 17 Lunar Roving Vehicle, Sojourner, and Spirit. Through their missions, discoveries, and lasting scientific contributions, the project introduces young space enthusiasts to the technology that helped humanity explore other worlds.
details: The Forgotten Explorers Three machines. Two worlds. Stories that outlived their missions. What happens to a spacecraft or rover when its mission comes to an end? Some remain on the Moon or Mars, far beyond the reach of repair crews. Although their operations eventually stop, the discoveries they made continue to shape our understanding of space. This project explores the stories of three NASA machines: 1. Apollo 17 Lunar Roving Vehicle – The Moon In December 1972, the Apollo 17 Lunar Roving Vehicle helped astronauts explore the lunar surface, travel greater distances, and collect scientific samples. It covered approximately 35.7 kilometres during the mission and remained on the Moon after the astronauts departed. 2. Sojourner – Mars In 1997, Sojourner became the first successful Mars rover. Originally planned for a seven-day mission, it operated for 83 days, examining Martian rocks and soil and sending valuable information back to Earth. 3. Spirit – Mars Spirit arrived on Mars in 2004 with a planned mission of 90 days. It continued operating for more than six years and helped scientists discover evidence of past water activity on Mars. Its mission officially ended in 2011. Our message These machines were not simply abandoned objects. They were scientific explorers that expanded human knowledge. Their missions ended, but their contributions remain. Through narration, historical NASA imagery, and clearly identified AI-generated illustrations, this documentary presents their stories in an engaging and accessible format for school-age space enthusiasts. The project was created as an educational storytelling response to the NASA Space Apps Challenge: Abandoned but Not Forgotten.
